# Kautusan Bayan No. 01, Series of 2005

**Revised Annual Budget for 2006**

## Summary

This ordinance approves the revised annual budget of [[₱26,896,356.88]] for the local government of Pitogo, Quezon for the year 2006. It details the appropriations for various expenditures and compliance with budgetary requirements, including allocations for barangay aid, salary reductions, calamity funds, and the 20% development fund. The ordinance was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo on December 19, 2005, and is set to take effect on January 1, 2006.

## Key Provisions

1.  **SAPAGKA'T**, the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo approved the Revised Annual Budget (Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01) for the year 2006, amounting to [[₱26,896,356.88]].
2.  **SEKSYON 1.** The budget is based on estimated revenues, including Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) of [[₱2,241,481.88]], totaling [[₱22,654,865.00]] for the year 2006, resulting in a total budget of [[₱26,896,356.88]].
3.  **SEKSYON 2.** The budget of [[₱26,896,356.88]] is allocated for various expenditures, resulting in a total appropriation of [[₱23,486,780.37]], leaving an unappropriated balance of [[₱1,409,576.51]].
4.  **SEKSYON 3.** The budget contains full provision for all Statutory and Contractual obligations.
5.  **SEKSYON 4.** Appropriates aid to component barangays set at at least [[₱39,000.00]] in conformance with the requirements of the code that at least [[₱1,000.00]] per barangay be appropriated.
6.  **SEKSYON 5.** Reduction of appropriation on salaries and wages-casual to comply with section 325 (a) known as the 55% general limitation as 5th class municipality.
7.  **SEKSYON 6.** The 5% calamity appropriation is included in the budget, amounting to [[₱26,896,356.88]].
8.  **SEKSYON 7.** The budget includes the 2% discretionary fund of the Municipal Mayor and the 20% Development Fund.
9.  **SEKSYON 8.** The Revised Annual Budget is prepared by the Municipal Mayor and is submitted as Annex "A".
10. **SEKSYON 9.** This ordinance regarding the Revised Annual Budget shall take effect on January 1, [[2006]].
11. **SEKSYON 10.** Approved this December 19, [[2005]] at Pitogo, Quezon.
